THE PRACTICAL PART

Refill. Clean. Repeat.

Open top feeding wells. Release modules for full cleaning.

The bowl is supported by printed struts, not a real beam or floating mechanism. Inspect the strut joints and the single integral hanger before loading.

What you need

A suitable printer, compatible filament, and appropriate outdoor suspension hardware. The integral eye suspends the assembled feeder; the cord or support is not a printed part. No camera, batteries, app or subscription are needed.

Supplied 3MF filament type: PETG. ASA is an outdoor alternative, not a drop-in profile substitution: change the profile, re-slice and test the fit. Use manufacturer ventilation guidance.

Download editable source ZIP

Assembly sequence

  1. Install feeding cup, lamp halo, then observation dome. The centered overhead hanger leaves dome removal clearance.
  2. Align each pair of keyed tangs with receiver towers. Press down until latch hooks engage.
  3. Attach one hanger to integral eye. Release each module by pressing both outer hook noses through the exposed receiver windows.

Before hanging it outdoors

  • One integrated eye supports the complete rigid assembly. No cord retention.
  • PETG or ASA; 0.4 mm nozzle; 0.20 mm layers; 4 walls. Test snap coupons and load before outdoor use.
  • 3.2 mm integrated floor drains. Empty damp seed and clean all removable wells.

Use shallow daily portions, remove wet seed, keep drains open, and inspect joints and suspension points. Test near the ground before installing over people, pets or property.
